Earlier scenes:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

This scene:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人：很聪明

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很聪明的人：是一个很聪明的人，To describe someone as a “smart person,” use the copula plus a measure word before the noun; an adjective predicate cannot be followed directly by a noun in this structure.
2. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 成为：成为了，Use 了 after the verb to mark the completed change of becoming a well-known person in this past narrative.

items.reason: “他很聪明的人” cannot use an adjective predicate directly before 人 here; adding 是一个 makes a correct nominal predicate.
The becoming is a completed change in the past story, so 成为 should take 了, although the shown target is only a clipped verb phrase.
